scope: Partial human reconstruction of RH and Dirichlet GRH. The prescribed-character cyclotomic host, all HostDer fields and trace-self-dual half-different are constructed under the literal prime and splitting hypotheses. Actual ambient periods, trace isometries, CM-j integrality and the normalized one-dimensional theta arithmetic are reconstructed. The local-index/nonvanishing and canonical replacement suppliers and the complete standard all-twist comparison are proved with their original data and interfaces. Multidimensional vacuum/indicator/covariance, the actual NChoice/TupTied arithmetic join, Pins.iX, all five Later stages, analytic prime/window and geometric point suppliers, and the four independent global branches remain. Named classical inputs are explicit. No complete self-contained RH/GRH proof, full Lean build or independent kernel replay is asserted.
range_convention: All line numbers are one-based inclusive. Ranges may include trailing comments or namespace endings before the next declaration.
status_convention: Source translations retain their hypotheses. Derived alternatives have written mathematical proofs but have not been replayed in Lean. Remaining inputs have not been supplied with complete human proofs.

claims.title: All selected normal prefix types inherit the original maximum-weight cutoffs
claims.statement: Canonical isotypic projectors for nested/disjoint prefixes commute. Joint-isotypic vectors span each finite-degree space, so the literal IsJProj condition determines the product projector uniquely. A nonzero selected normal vector therefore has each selected type present; its largest coordinate is bounded by the original segment normal-prefix maximum. No integral direct sum or projector-denominator estimate is used.
claims.background: Ordinary characteristic-zero complete reducibility and highest-weight extremal-weight facts, already used in v0_5 PG/IW. The report supplies the precise commutation, uniqueness, homogeneous-filtering and prefix identification argument.

Signed label costs dS+dV<=kNsP and the individual determinant order s_x prove every fine gap, threshold and normal-order condition, with correct even/odd prefix indices and supports.

Local label e is late-supported and every exponent is <P_j.

claims.title: Actual paired lift assembly and the pre-transport HH RhoGE certificate
claims.statement: For supplied GoodShare data D_j,kappa_j>=0 and c>4D*, D*=sum_j D_j+4kappa0, the actual CCe/CCe' at floor(t0) have RhoGE depth D* and mass (1-kappaP-sum_j kappa_j)dimHH/gaussian(q,k). This is HerrExtensionClass / aux3 before harmonic transport.
assumptions: The path-dimension calculations use a characteristic-zero fraction field K of a DVR O, r>=1 and k=r+1; the actual quadratic coefficient setting implies characteristic zero.
Actual segments, compatible digits, kept blocks, levels and prefix cutoffs retain their literal definitions; all sets used in the counts have proved finite support.
RU4-RU8 are pointwise under the literal Std(C0,Cde,CE1,CE2,H,X), H>=1. NP2 supplies this record uniformly; the numerical threshold theorem is not reproved here.
The exact integral path basis and prefix adaptation are prior proved IP3-IP4; CB3 supplies the exact tableau dimension, and SW1/SW10 supply the named actual block and degree interfaces.
Elementary field extension, polynomial coefficient algebra, finite-dimensional linear algebra and DVR/Smith normal form are declared classical background.
For the actual combined application: C0>=880, Std(H=4), CE1,CE2,Cm>=17, Ct>=30 and RL11's actual kept/order premises as supplied by NP/RL.
Final depth D0 and loss kx require the separately proved numerical choices of GoodShare data; harmonic transport and global RH/GRH are outside RU.
claims.source_relation: The proof checks both off-diagonal block-pattern cases, then explicitly inverts I+E over O and scales to one diagonal value. It retains p^AHH, w^2=p, source precision c>4D*, and all CCe/CCe' conditions. It gives a supplied-GoodShare theorem, not an unproved assertion of those data.

claims.title: Construct the literal standard coefficient ring and all its quadratic-setting properties
claims.statement: For p>=5 prime and even f>=2, O_s=W(F_(p^(2f)))[omega]/(omega^2-p) is the complete DVR with uniformizer omega, residue cardinal p^(2f), a finite rank-four structural map from W(F_(p^f)), compatible Frobenius period f, and a square root of every integer. This is the actual settingStd record.
assumptions: All coefficient rings in the application are DVR domains with compatible fraction-field embeddings. The source unramified ring W, its field Q, Frobenius and lattice edges stay fixed.

BC1 uses the literal p>=5, f>=2 and Even f. Its field/Witt-vector existence and Teichmuller expansions are declared classical background; the required finite, quadratic, square-root and residue properties are proved in the report.
BC2 proves the complete-DVR integral-closure and chosen-place construction, using only standard characteristic-zero separability, trace linear algebra and number-field integer-ring facts.
CB1-CB2 and CB7 are prior proved integral tableau-basis/change-of-basis results; no integral semisimplicity premise is introduced.

The full globally compatible family is not constructed here. The pointwise StdSubAt conclusion applies to recC data or supplied RingCompatibleAt identifications. Eventual compatible ring data can come from IsRecCEv or directly from GroupCompatibilityFamily; neither route is required simultaneously with the other.
claims.source_relation: Residue-basis lifting proves rank two for W2/W, and the opposite-parity valuation gives the quadratic DVR directly. The source name does not mean O_s/W is unramified: its ramification and residue degrees are both two.

claims.statement: For a finite compatible inclusion R->S of DVRs, S has an R-basis beginning with 1. claims.title: Explicit unramified lifting and exact completion comparison
claims.statement: For an unramified number-field prime P over p of residue degree m, construct a Good embedding into Q_m=Frac(W(F_(p^m))). Conversely, every such Good embedding identifies the actual completion with Q_m and its integer ring with W_m, compatibly with the original number field.
assumptions: The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.

Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.

For the forward direction the prime is unramified; for the converse the three literal Good clauses are given. The converse itself implies unramifiedness.

The true column datum I with literal Ok, Pins and Later is supplied. Laws may be taken from independent TL13; Law0 is constructed in TX10.

No separate realizability, all-twist chart, common-character, chain, terminal vector, moving-element or period-comparison existence premise is used.

No Lean compilation, kernel replay, proof of supplied arithmetic/analytic inputs, RH or GRH is asserted.

The true column datum I with literal Ok, Pins and Later is supplied. Laws may be taken from independent TL13; Law0 is constructed in TX10.
